summary: Making a dead reducer reachable exposed a second live defect behind it: Model.loadM5Room re-reads shop stock from FloorGeneration.ShopStock on every entry and nothing wrote the emptied offers back, so leaving a shop and returning restored every slot it had sold. Harmless while nothing could buy; an unbounded item engine the instant a key press reaches the reducer.
evidence: command:dotnet fsi probe -> update (EnterM5Room shop) then InteractM5Shop 2 then EnterM5Room shop then InteractM5Shop 2 -> PlayerItems ['choir-bell';'choir-bell'], coins 99->86->73;file:src/Rogue3/Model.fs loadM5Room (tryPick over ShopStock, no writer);file:src/Rogue3/Model.fs withShopStock (the fix, mirroring withoutRewardFixture);file:tests/Rogue3.Tests/M14ItemGrantTests.fs 'a bought slot stays bought when the player leaves and comes back'
cost: about 40 minutes to find, fix and pin; it was found only because a mutation survivor prompted asking what else the room's durable state does not record
owner: EHotwagner/rogue3 src/Rogue3/Model.fs room durability rule (14.15) - the rule existed for obstacles and the reward plinth and was never applied to shop stock
